text:
nico_pm: Kicking off discussion for a new paid offering: Throughput Assurance Pack (TAP). Idea: simple bands + optional overage credits. Key asks: pricing shape, pilot terms, SLA language, and ops gating.

yasmin_eng: short tech view: implementable as a banded reservation with soft-lease semantics. Cheap pilot: tag routes with "assure:high" and route to a priority work queue. Enforcement via token-bucket per-lease + a fast path for cold cache hits. Need metrics for reserved_vs_consumed and a lease audit log.

pete_ops: Ops notes: isolation and exhaustion behavior are main risks. Propose behavior: 1) serve from reserved pool, 2) if exhausted, queue up to 250ms, 3) after queue -> best-effort lane with X-downgrade header and alert to customer and SRE. Also want automatic scaling hints and runbook.

leah_sales: Field wants clarity. Customers prefer band names (TAP-100, TAP-400, TAP-1600) and a simple monthly charge. They also asked for a utilization dashboard + recommendations (downgrade band if <40% used). Pilot ask: onboarding credit + migration day. Keep offer one-line on invoice.

martin_fin: Bands are easiest for forecasting. Alternative: base band + $/rps overage with credits applied if utilization exceeds threshold. I'll run unit economics. Target margin 35%+ after infra and support. Also need to consider reserved GPU capacity cost vs expected utilization.

anu_legal: Contract considerations: define "Assurance" (we're leaning soft-lease with contractual SLA for served requests), define exclusions (maintenance, DDoS, user errors), and cap on monthly credits (suggest max = monthly TAP fee). For pilots: add a nonprecedent clause and a short-term addendum that converts to GA terms on renewal.

nico_pm: Proposal for pricing shape (field + finance + product): banded SKU + optional metered overage with automatic credits if avg utilization > 80% for billing period (credit = 50% of overage charges that month). Rationale: encourages efficient use while protecting customers during spikes. Thoughts?

leah_sales: Love the credit trigger idea — good sales tool to reduce objections. Make sure the credit calc is simple to explain.

martin_fin: OK but we need a conservative forecast: model 60% utilization baseline and a 25% pilot conversion uplift. If credits trigger too often customers will game bands; add a min-charge equal to 50% of band price if usage < 20% to prevent perverse incentives.

yasmin_eng: Implementation note: we'll implement leases with start/end time and optional auto-renew flag. API sketch: 
```
POST /tap/lease {route, band, start_iso, duration_days, auto_renew:false}
GET /tap/lease/{id} -> {band, remaining_seconds, used_rps_estimate}
```
We'll emit metrics: tap_lease_reserved_rps, tap_lease_consumed_rps, tap_lease_queue_ms, tap_lease_fallback_count. Need ~6 weeks for pilot shim.

pete_ops: Ops gating checklist I'd require for GA: 
- staging SLO: 99p latency for reserved requests at 1.5x load
- exhaustion test harness + runbook
- customer-visible dashboard metrics + alerting
- billing pipeline shows TAP line-item and credit computations

anu_legal: SLA draft snippet to iterate: "We guarantee 99th percentile latency for requests served from the TAP reserved pool under normal operation. If we fail to meet this, we will issue service credits as defined, subject to exclusions and an overall monthly credit cap." Define "normal operation" & exclusions in the addendum.

nico_pm: Launch gating proposal: 
1) 3 pilot customers signed to different bands (small/medium/large)
2) staging SLO + chaos exhaustion pass
3) console: lease UI + usage recommendations + billing preview
4) legal: pilot addendum approved + GA SLA template
5) finance: P&L for bands approved

leah_sales: Can we do pilots with a discounted first month (40%) and a free migration SE day? Also request an admin toggle to bump a customer down to best-effort for testing.

martin_fin: Discount ok for pilots; model conversion sensitivity. Also set a GA discount policy to avoid long-term revenue erosion.

pete_ops: I'll start a synthetic harness and an exhaustion playbook. Also want alerts for long periods of low utilization (to recommend band downsell).

yasmin_eng: I'll produce an engineering epic with tickets: proxy tag, lease service, metrics, fallback header, billing hook. ETA: pilot shim in ~6 weeks if we deprioritize autoscale integration.

release-bot: release-bot: pushed tap-lease-service to staging at 2025-09-02T08:10Z — basic smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:

nico_pm: Action owners recap: Yasmin = engineering epic + ETA, Martin = P&L bands, Anu = pilot addendum + SLA bullets, Leah = pilot shortlist & outreach, Pete = ops harness + runbook. Check-in next Wed 9am PT. If anyone objects to the 3-pilot gate DM me. :thumbsup:
